meta.title: Enemy Pack V2 Story Candidates
meta.source: V2 enemy design pass published from authoring to current runtime pack
notes: Standard wrapped enemy pack. Editors must use meta.enums as the data source for enum controls.
Runtime readers may accept legacy bare enemy records, but published packs should keep this wrapped form.
Bleed and poison are battle-local pressure states; only resulting hp and armor state carry between levels.

fieldNotes.$schemaVersion: Enemy pack schema version. Current value: enemies_v2_1.
fieldNotes.meta.enums: Authoritative enum domains for editor controls. UI must not infer these domains from visible rows when this metadata exists.
fieldNotes.enemies: Enemy template dictionary. Key is enemy id; value is EnemyTemplate.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.id: Stable enemy template id. It should match the enclosing enemies dictionary key.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.name: Display name. Free text, should be localized for player/editor readability.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.class: Enemy role/class archetype. Select from meta.enums.classes.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.tags[]: Search, progression, pressure, and role tags. Select from meta.enums.tags.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.candidateForLevel: Story level id this V2 candidate is designed to cover, for example level_1_1.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.stats.ap: Enemy AP budget used by planner legality checks.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.bodyParts: Body part armor dictionary. Keys should come from meta.enums.bodyParts.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.skills[]: Enemy skill ids. Values must resolve in the enemy skill pack.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.mechanicProfile: Design-only mechanic slot, role, target turn, budget, and failure explanation.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.capabilities[].type: Enemy-owned mechanism capability. Select from meta.enums.capabilityTypes.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.capabilities[].cadence: Design pacing hint only. Select from meta.enums.capabilityCadences. Current runtime does not trigger abilities from this field; executable turn order comes from enemies.*.intentModel.pattern[].
fieldNotes.enemies.*.capabilities[].pressure: Design/diagnostic pressure category only. Select from meta.enums.capabilityPressures; it groups pressure types and is not a runtime trigger.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.capabilities[].counterplay[]: Player response tags for this capability. Select from meta.enums.counterplay; multiple values are allowed and they describe intended player answers, not enemy AI branches.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.intentModel.pattern[]: Fixed runtime intent-loop token sequence. Tokens come from meta.enums.intentTokens and are consumed by EnemyActionPlanner.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.intentModel.fallback: Fallback intent token. Value comes from meta.enums.intentTokens.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.buildCheck: Design diagnostics describing what player build weakness this enemy verifies.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.runPressure.type: Whole-run pressure role. Select from meta.enums.runPressureTypes.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.runPressure.carryoverImpact[]: Whole-run impact tags caused by this enemy. Select from meta.enums.carryoverImpact.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.statePersistence.carryOver[]: States allowed to carry to the next level. Select from meta.enums.carryOver.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.statePersistence.clearAfterBat: Battle-local states cleared after combat. Select from meta.enums.clearAfterBattle.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.presentation: Presentation and asset references for editor, map, and battle UI.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.runPressure.counterplay[]: Player response tags for the whole-run pressure. Select from meta.enums.counterplay; multiple values are allowed.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.mode: Runtime decision model mode. Select from meta.enums.decisionModelModes; current supported value is intent_priority_table.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.intentTimeline[]: Visible runtime intent timeline. Values come from meta.enums.intentTokens and mirror intentModel.pattern during migration.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.fallbackIntent: Fallback intent token. Value comes from meta.enums.intentTokens.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].priori: Numeric action priority. Higher values are checked first in ActionPriorityTable.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].when: Explicit condition object for the action. Select the condition type from meta.enums.decisionWhenTypes; current runtime supports always, selfHpRatioLte/Gte, previousIntent, and turnNumberModulo.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].intent: Action intent token. Select from meta.enums.intentTokens.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].skillI: Enemy skill id. Select from meta.enums.enemySkillIds; it must also be listed in this enemy skills[] and resolve in the enemy skill pack.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].target: Target rule token. Select from meta.enums.decisionTargetRules when possible.
fieldNotes.enemies.*.decisionModel.actions[].telegr: Boolean warning marker. Use for high-threat or visible telegraph actions; not an enum field.

capabilityCadences.every_turn: 设计节奏：可持续出现；实际是否使用仍由意图循环、AP 和技能合法性决定。
capabilityCadences.alternating_turns: 设计节奏：隔回合压力；不是运行时固定 if-else。
capabilityCadences.cooldown_2_turns: 设计节奏：约两回合一次的压力密度；具体冷却必须由技能字段或 planner 支持。
capabilityCadences.cooldown_3_turns: 设计节奏：约三回合一次的压力密度；不是手写冷却字符串。
capabilityCadences.cooldown_4_turns: 设计节奏：低频高压能力；不是必定触发器。
capabilityCadences.windup_1_turn: 设计节奏：先预兆或铺垫一回合，再兑现压力。
capabilityCadences.windup_2_turns: 设计节奏：两步铺垫后兑现，适合高伤害或组合技。
capabilityCadences.intent_loop_slot: 设计节奏：由 intentModel.pattern 中的位置表达；当前运行时不读取 capability.cadence 触发。

capabilityPressures.hp_attrition: 流程压力：稳定磨血，最终转化为跨关 HP 损失。
capabilityPressures.armor_attrition: 流程压力：消耗护甲或迫使补甲，影响下一关状态。
capabilityPressures.burst_damage: 单关压力：高伤害窗口，要求预判、防御、打断或爆发处理。
capabilityPressures.status_dot: 单关压力：流血/中毒/易伤等战斗内状态，不跨关保留。
capabilityPressures.control_tempo: 节奏压力：减速、束缚、行动税或顺序扰动。
capabilityPressures.delay_sustain: 拖延压力：治疗、修复、吸血或延长战斗来扩大消耗。
capabilityPressures.counter_punish: 反制压力：惩罚无脑攻击、被动 DOT 锁或错误节奏。
capabilityPressures.priority_target: 优先级压力：迫使玩家先处理支援、光环或关键单位。
capabilityPressures.progression_exam: 进度考核：门卫/Boss/阶段综合检查，不代表运行时阶段触发。

counterplay.guard: 防御/格挡/低 AP 防守。
counterplay.armor_up: 提前补甲或维持护甲余量。
counterplay.armor_break: 破甲，削弱护甲墙或修复链。
counterplay.cleanse: 净化流血、中毒、标记、易伤等状态。
counterplay.interrupt: 打断预兆、铺垫、姿态或修复动作。
counterplay.fast_kill: 快速击杀，缩短磨血或爆发窗口。
counterplay.burst_window: 在暴露/净化后/预兆后窗口集中爆发。
counterplay.weakpoint_focus: 选择弱点或关键部位进行输出。
counterplay.read_telegraph: 读懂预兆、阶段或意图循环。
counterplay.stop_attack: 暂停攻击，避免触发反击或惩罚窗口。
counterplay.speed_management: 速度管理，避免被减速和控制拖垮。
counterplay.resource_save: 保留 AP、护甲、爆发或治疗资源。
counterplay.target_priority: 先处理支援/光环/关键单位。
counterplay.stable_output: 稳定输出，避免只靠单次爆发。
